outputMask reaches text embed files, and its contract is written: HtmlReportWriter.writeEmbedFile decodes a part whose mime is not ResourceType.isBinary as UTF-8 (strict — bytes that are not UTF-8 pass through), applies the mask and re-encodes; a binary part is written byte-identical; the FEATURE_EXIT seam (Suite.fireEvent → externalizeEmbeds) and the HTML pass (prepareFeatureData) both carry the Suite's mask. No byte mask: a credential is not a contiguous byte run in a compressed or pixel payload, and a splice into an offset-bearing container corrupts it. Runner.Builder.outputMask's javadoc states the contract — input is the serialized document text (a value as JSON/XML escapes it, base64 where the format carries bytes: a JSON embed part inline in page data and JSONL, a step log and inline embeds in Cucumber JSON), output must be valid in the same format, applied per write. configure logging.mask stays the source-side API: core writes no HTTP-derived content but the HttpLogger text, masked at the capture, so a header/jsonPath value reaches no artifact (LogMaskReportArtifactsTest, which passes before this change and guards it); an ext building an embed from HTTP_EXIT applies LogContext.get().getMask() itself (DESIGN.md § Mask scope, EXT.md § Embeds). DESIGN.md § Output mask; UnaryOperator imported rather than fully qualified. OutputMaskTest +1 (text embed file masked, binary byte-identical — failed before the fix); karate-js 1818/0/0, karate-core 2818/0/0.
